description: offgridders, published by rl-institut, builds user-defined electricity supply systems and optimises generation, storage, conversion and dispatch using the Open Energy Modelling Framework. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is GPL-3.0. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The README specifies a legacy Python 3.6 environment and linearised component models; current compatibility is untested. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support optimisation, capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
